description: Use this when the user wants to answer a received proposal with different terms instead of accepting or declining it. Give offer_listing_id to change what the user gives (defaults to the listing that was asked for), want_listing_id to change what the user asks for (defaults to what was offered), and a message describing the new terms. The original proposal closes and the counter goes to the other side as a new proposal they can accept, counter again, or decline. Confirm the terms with the user first.

message.description: The changed terms, in the user's words

offer_listing_id.description: One of the user's listings to give

want_listing_id.description: One of the other member's listings to ask for

name: counter_proposal
title: Counter a proposal
